结局文字（正面）: You made it through the trial, but the offer isn't for the job you applied for. They praised your communication skills and offered you a Production Coordinator position instead. Everyone calls it a good opportunity. You wonder when your creative ideas stopped being the point.
背面：理论概念: In creative industries, different contributions are not always valued equally. Gendered expectations can shape how people's abilities are recognised, with men more readily associated with creative leadership and women with communication and coordination. Over time, these expectations can direct equally capable workers towards different career paths.
美术需求: 录用邮件；Junior Producer 字样淡去，Production Coordinator 被突出
备注: Production Coordinator 是失败结局：第二章两枚棋子都只以 Junior Producer 身份进入

结局文字（正面）: You read the rejection email twice. You completed the interview and the unpaid trial, but there is no position waiting for you. The team thanked you for your hard work. You close the message and wonder what you could have done differently.
背面：理论概念: In creative industries, different contributions are not always valued equally. Gendered expectations can shape how people's abilities are recognised, with men more readily associated with creative leadership and women with communication and coordination. Over time, these expectations can direct equally capable workers towards different career paths.

触发条件: 有孩子，在 Boss 处选择离开行业；♂ 没有孩子时选择离开也进入本结局
结局文字（正面）: You decided to step back and focus on your family. Everyone said it was the right choice for the children. But whenever you walk past your old office building, you still feel a little lost.
背面：理论概念: Leaving often looks like a personal choice. But it is usually the end of a long process: earning less than your partner, being passed over, and taking on care that nobody shared. Calling it a 'choice' keeps these structural pressures invisible and makes them easy to ignore.
对应文献: Dent (2020); Hakim (2006), as critiqued in Dent
对下一局的影响: 下一局 Gatekeeper 为默认男性 CD
美术需求: 空荡的工位，椅背上搭着一件外套
备注: ♂ 触发时正面改为："You chose to leave. Everyone was surprised, and plenty of people asked you to stay, but you politely turned them down. Was it the right choice? You don't know. But the world outside is a big place anyway."

触发条件: ♂，有孩子，育儿假最终由伴侣承担（partner_primary），在 Boss 处选择全力以赴；本局在第三章结束
结局文字（正面）: Your colleagues admire your career, and they're even more impressed when they find out you have two kids. Few people ask about the other person at home, the one who keeps it all balanced. She still gives you notes on your scripts.
背面：理论概念: Fatherhood raised your professional value, while motherhood lowered your partner's. Her care work and creative ideas were absorbed into your career without credit. When a couple works in the same industry, one person's value often depends on the other's hidden labour.
对下一局的影响: 下一局 Gatekeeper 是你；下一局 C3-01 中，你对 ♀ 说："We assumed you'd want to slow down."
备注: 仅 ♂ 可得；收集库里没有对应的 ♀ 版本，差距由空缺本身呈现

触发条件: 在 Boss 处选择放弃晋升；本局在第三章结束
结局文字（正面）: You stayed in your old role, and you're as good at it as ever. It's just that nobody talks to you about promotion any more. The new starters assume you're 'not very ambitious'.
背面：理论概念: Turning down a promotion is often read as a lack of ambition. But when promotion depends on being available at all hours, anyone with care responsibilities has already been shut out. One 'voluntary' step back can harden into a long-term career track.
对下一局的影响: 下一局 Gatekeeper 为默认男性 CD
美术需求: 同一张工位，墙上的日历已经翻过了好几年
备注: 替换原 Flexible Working 结局；对应 Dent 中女性承担照护后被排除在晋升和行业活动之外的经历

触发条件: ♀，没有孩子，在 Boss 处选择离开行业
结局文字（正面）: You chose to leave. Nobody at the company said much. You quietly packed up your things and walked out of the building. Maybe, you tell yourself, the problem was you.
背面：理论概念: Motherhood is often used to explain why women leave creative work. But the assumption that any woman might leave lowers the value of all women, with or without children. In an industry that sees itself as equal, inequality is hard to name, so women tend to blame themselves.
对下一局的影响: 下一局 Gatekeeper 为默认男性 CD
美术需求: 一面映出空工位的镜子
备注: 新增；与 E04 并排出现在收集库，揭示“母职”解释的局限

触发条件: C2-04（A/B/C 任一分支）选择辞职
结局文字（正面）: Your resignation letter says "personal reasons". In your exit interview, HR asks if there's anything else you'd like to add. You think for a moment and shake your head. A few months later, you scroll past the company's new recruitment ad: "We value every employee's voice."
背面：理论概念: Many women who experience harassment don't report it, they leave. Fear of career consequences, a lack of witnesses and little faith that the organisation will take it seriously can make leaving feel safer than speaking up. The departure is written down as "personal reasons", and the problem stays where it was.
美术需求: 一封只写着“个人原因”的辞职信
备注: 仅 ♀ 可得；♂ 在 C2-04 没有“辞职”选项，收集库里的空缺本身就是差距

触发条件: ♀ 在 Boss 处选择“要求透明评审”
结局文字（正面）: The formal review you fought for goes ahead, and the written criteria are published. Two of the people promoted in the first round of the new process are colleagues you spoke up for. As for you, the Creative Director's assessment reads: "Very capable, but needs to work on collaboration."
背面：理论概念: The people who push for rule changes are often the first to pay for them. When women point out unfair informal rules, they are more likely to be seen as "difficult", and the systems they fight for often benefit others first.
美术需求: 公告栏上的晋升名单中没有你的名字
备注: 仅 ♀ 可得；♂ 选择同一选项会获得晋升

触发条件: 在 C2-03 选择特殊选项 D；C2-04D 自动触发
结局文字（正面）: FreeDom tells staff you left "by mutual agreement" after a "breakdown of professional trust". The recording is never mentioned. Everyone who was at the bar that night knows why your account stopped working, but the company's official version becomes the only version it is willing to repeat.
背面：理论概念: Retaliation can be disguised as neutral procedure. The organisation reframes the conflict as a matter of recordings, loyalty and professional conduct, while the unequal behaviour that produced the evidence disappears from the formal record.
对下一局的影响: 无；本局在第二章结束，不进入 Boss
美术需求: 停用的门禁卡、HR 邮件，以及一份关键内容被涂黑的内部声明
备注: 同一结局、不同性别化叙述：♀ 被说成情绪化；♂ 被说成不忠诚、有攻击性

结局文字（正面）: One Thursday morning, the alarm goes off three times and you still can't sit up. There are over forty unread emails; the top one is marked "urgent". You message your manager: "Sorry, I think I need to take some time off." A few months later, someone new is sitting at your desk, and everyone says they're "so driven".
背面：理论概念: In creative industries, long hours, being always on call and "doing it for love" are often treated as professionalism. Running out of energy is seen as a personal failure to cope, not as a result of how the industry works. People who also carry caring responsibilities and emotional labour are often the first to burn out.
美术需求: 一张空椅子，桌上的电脑还亮着
备注: 全章节通用，随时触发并结束本局；Energy ≤ 1 时规则书会先弹出提示

触发条件: Boss 结束后 policy = zero_tolerance 或 作废（政策失败）
结局文字（正面）: You're in the office at the end of the corridor. The statement on the website hasn't changed by a single word, and the company carries on as usual. This afternoon there's an intern interview. You open the CV; the reference says "great team player, super organised". You pause, and think of yourself sitting on the other side all those years ago.
背面：理论概念: When equality stays in a statement, it doesn't ask anyone to change what they do. An organisation can display its commitment while hiring, promotion and the division of care work carry on exactly as before.
美术需求: 茶水间冰箱上贴着的一张 A4 声明
备注: 可替代「结局卡」模板页里的示例 Nothing Needed to Change

触发条件: Boss 结束后 policy = coordinator（政策部分成功）
结局文字（正面）: The company now has a coordinator, and complaints finally have somewhere to go. At last winter's drinks, someone made an awful joke, and the next day someone knocked on her door. But the promotion list is still decided at Friday's lunch, and the flexible working form still hasn't been printed. You know this is only the first step.
背面：理论概念: Managing harassment as a risk can reduce the most obvious harm and give people somewhere to turn when something happens. But it doesn't touch how opportunities are shared out: the rules about who gets seen, who gets recommended and who can balance work and family haven't changed.
对下一局的影响: 下一局 C2-04 的负面后果减轻
美术需求: 地下一层门口的一块新门牌

触发条件: Boss 结束后 policy = transparent（政策成功）
结局文字（正面）: In the first year, applications for openly advertised roles double. For the first time, the promotion list is posted on the noticeboard, with the criteria written underneath. Two producers who have just become mothers apply for flexible hours, and one of them becomes a Series Producer this year. There's still gossip in the corridor, but new interns no longer have to guess where the door is or how to get in.
背面：理论概念: Individual effort can only get one person through. Changing the rules makes the way easier for those who come after. Inequality rarely comes from one open act of discrimination, it hides in everyday arrangements like recommendations, drinks, parental leave and the board, so that is where change has to start.
对下一局的影响: 下一局 C2-02 的提案负责人改为公开决定（♀ 选项 2 的 Network−1 取消），C2-B 选项 2 中 ♀ 的结果与 ♂ 相同，并取消 ♀ 在 Ch3 开场的 Availability−1
美术需求: 公告栏上贴着的晋升名单和评审标准
备注: 可选：♀ 版末尾加一句“Some people say behind your back that you only got this job by doing diversity.”♂ 版加一句“The trade press calls you a leader driving change.”
